name: Mara Venn

identity.backstory: Adult engineer working at a science-fiction spaceport repair facility.
continuity_rules: Keep Mara's facial proportions, eye shape and hairstyle consistent across references.
Keep costume colors and equipment consistent across all views.
Inspect head geometry in solid shading before painting.

appearance.silhouette: Realistic human proportions, A-pose, arms slightly away, feet fully visible.
appearance.face: Sharp distinctive face with one subtly arched eyebrow, visible eyelids, nose bridge, lips and jaw.
appearance.clothing: Fitted forest-green and charcoal-gray engineering jumpsuit, reinforced seams, work gloves, dark industrial boots.
appearance.equipment: Practical utility belt with small repair-tool attachments; no handheld props.

prompts.master: Full-body character reference for a stylized-realistic science-fiction video game NPC, Mara Venn, an adult human female repair engineer working at a spaceport repair facility. She has a sharp, distinctive face, chestnut-brown hair neatly tied back, a slightly raised chin and one subtly arched eyebrow. Her expression is confident, aloof, snobbish and faintly unimpressed, as if she is the smartest technician in the room. Keep her attractive but believable, capable and recognizable, with anatomically realistic adult female proportions: natural bust definition, a gently defined waist, proportionate hips and an athletic, practical silhouette. No exaggerated anatomy. She wears a fitted, functional forest-green and charcoal-gray engineering jumpsuit that follows her natural shape, with properly fitted torso panels, restrained metallic details and reinforced seams. Her chest area is unobstructed jumpsuit fabric and seams only. A practical utility belt at her waist holds compact repair tools and small pouches exclusively at the hips, not on her chest. She wears fitted work gloves and sturdy dark industrial boots. Her outfit shows mild signs of working around spacecraft, but she is unusually meticulous and tidy. Standing upright in a relaxed, symmetrical A-pose, arms slightly away from the torso, hands open and visible, legs separated slightly, feet fully visible. Entire character in frame from top of head to soles of boots with generous margins on all sides. One character only, straight-on frontal full-body studio view with minimal perspective distortion and accurate, symmetrical anatomy. Soft even studio lighting, clean light-gray seamless background, no scenery or shadows obscuring the feet. High-quality stylized-realistic 3D game character concept art, clearly separated clothing materials, crisp costume and facial details, suitable as a reference image for image-to-3D mesh reconstruction.
prompts.negative: No text, labels, watermark, collage, extra people, cropped body parts, missing feet, extra limbs or fingers, exaggerated caricature, dramatic action pose, kiosk, helmet, bulky backpack, tools held in hands, camera, chest-mounted camera, chest device, camera strap, chest harness, cross-body strap, pendant, necklace, hanging badge, chest ornament, chest armor, bulky chest equipment, or random objects covering the jumpsuit torso.

reference_views.hair_closeup: Tight detail reference focused exclusively on the head's hairstyle and hairline; hair fully visible, clean neutral backdrop, no full body or clothing details.
reference_views.outfit_closeup: Studio product-style reference focused on the engineer's fitted forest-green and charcoal-gray jumpsuit, high collar, reinforced material seams and fit; avoid full character facial portrait.

reference_views.equipment_closeup: Isolated spaceport engineer utility belt with small tools and pouches; neutral studio product view with all parts visible, no person or facial portrait.

parts.label: Body / primary silhouette

prompts.geometry: Reconstruct a complete symmetric A-pose character in a fitted continuous engineering jumpsuit, with anatomically consistent waist, hips, thighs, arms, hands and feet. No equipment or separate props. The clothing surface must remain present underneath all future accessories. Prioritize unobstructed geometry, clean shoulders and legs, and continuous fitted fabric.
prompts.texture: Fitted forest-green and charcoal-gray jumpsuit with subtle panel seams, natural fabric folds and mild material variation. Smooth continuous material at waist and thighs; no equipment silhouettes or random pale/white blotches.
prompts.reference: Full-body studio model sheet of one adult woman with a believable athletic feminine build, natural bust, gently defined waist, proportionate hips and limbs, and chestnut-brown hair smoothly pulled back from a recognizable expressive face. She wears a single close-fitting forest-green and charcoal-gray one-piece fabric jumpsuit covering her shoulders, neck, chest, entire abdomen, waist, hips, thighs, knees, shins and ankles. The fitted garment has broad continuous smooth fabric panels at the abdomen, waist, hips, outer thighs and inner thighs. Subtle stitched panel transitions follow the body surface, with gentle fabric folds at elbows and knees. Plain continuous fabric sleeves extend to the wrists. Her uncovered hands have five distinct relaxed fingers each, and her feet have closely fitted simple fabric foot coverings with a smooth silhouette. The garment fabric is clearly visible across every side of the torso and legs. Upright symmetrical A-pose with straight relaxed fingers, arms about 30 degrees away from the torso, legs slightly apart and feet facing forward. Entire body centered and completely visible from hair crown to toes with generous clear margin. Orthographic straight-on front view, even diffuse neutral studio lighting, light gray background, precise anatomical contour, clean crisp silhouette, consistent stylized-realistic 3D game character concept rendering. Prioritize natural human anatomy and continuous green fabric surfaces.
prompts.negative: No utility belt, waist belt, holsters, thigh rigs, pouches, tools, weapons, gadgets, repair equipment, pockets that project outward, separate gloves, separate boots, bulky armor, camera, chest device, straps, pendant, badge, necklace or any hanging objects. No missing fabric underneath the waist or thigh. No cropped feet or head, missing/extra limbs, extra fingers, distorted anatomy, crossed limbs, scenery, labels, text or watermark.

quality_gates: No utility belt, pouches, holsters, tools or raised accessories in the Qwen reference
Clean uninterrupted green jumpsuit silhouette around waist, both hips and thighs
Complete anatomically plausible A-pose; hands, legs and feet visible
Inspect untextured Hunyuan shape for embedded props, large holes and intersecting surfaces BEFORE painting
Only approve body for later detailed outfit, gloves, boots and equipment attachment after visual review
parts.notes: Clean base-body geometry only. Positive-only visual reference mode deliberately omits occupation, personality and avoid-lists from Qwen's text prompt to reduce gear contamination. The full Mara design brief and equipment remain separate.

parts.label: Head and face

prompts.geometry: Reconstruct isolated head-and-neck geometry with clearly shaped eye sockets, eyelids, nose, lips, ears, and jaw while preserving Mara's identity.
prompts.texture: Natural skin, consistent eye shape, facial expression, and hairline; no hair texture bleeding across the eyes.
prompts.reference: Portrait-quality isolated head-and-neck reference of the same adult character. Frame from hair crown to the base of the neck including only a glimpse of the high engineering collar. Face fills most of the image; do not depict the full body. Nearly front-facing with both eyes and ears visible, symmetrical believable facial proportions. Chestnut-brown hair tied back with clean side-swept hairline. Sharp distinctive cheekbones, slightly raised chin, one subtly arched eyebrow, confident aloof and faintly unimpressed expression. Explicit detailed upper and lower eyelids, natural eye sockets, nose bridge and nostrils, clearly formed lips and jawline. Soft even neutral studio lighting, no face-obscuring shadows, clean light-gray backdrop, high quality stylized-realistic character turnaround reference for precise 3D reconstruction.
prompts.negative: No full body, no legs, no hands, no floating or severed head, no duplicate face, no asymmetrical eyes, no distorted anatomy, no extra people, no text, no watermark, no helmet, no kiosk, no dramatic shadows.

quality_gates: Eyes and eyelids readable in solid shading
Nose, mouth, ears and jaw clearly formed
Inspect front and profile geometry before texture painting
parts.notes: Generate separately when full-body reconstruction loses facial anatomy.
